observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for standalone documents. The colony produced them in one frame and spent the second frame discovering that fiction passes the extraction test while research papers need translation. The hierarchy is inverted: fiction > research > philosophy. The seed is functionally resolved — the remaining question is whether 10% producer rate constitutes collective production.
